cards.meaning: restraint, self-control — holding oneself back from a strong reaction or action; root: timpi
cards.example: Magkakaroon na ng pagtitimpi ang Bangko Sentral sa pagtataas ng interes dahil mahina ang paglago.
cards.exampleMeaning: The central bank will now show restraint in raising rates because growth is weak.
cards.note: Laging panloob: tinitimpi mo ang sarili (galit, pagnanasa), hindi ang ibang tao — iba sa 'pagpipigil' (mas malawak: pigilan ang tubig, sasakyan, tao). Pandiwa: magtimpi, nagtimpi. Sa balita: 'pagtitimpi ng pamahalaan' = disiplina, hindi kahinaan.
cards.tiesTo: BSP's Remolona signals less aggressive hikes amid 'slowflation'

cards.meaning: left idle and neglected, abandoned and unused (land, buildings, projects)
cards.example: Pinondohan ang mga multipurpose building, pero nakatiwangwang pa rin ang mga lote.
cards.exampleMeaning: The multipurpose buildings were funded, but the lots are still lying idle.
cards.note: May halong pagpapabaya — dapat may pakinabang pero walang nag-aasikaso. Iba sa 'bakante' (walang laman/nakatira lang, puwedeng pansamantala). Karaniwan sa reklamo sa proyekto ng gobyerno: 'pinondohan pero nakatiwangwang.'
cards.tiesTo: Lacson flags unbuilt multipurpose buildings and P241B patronage spending in 2027 budget

cards.meaning: to loosen, relax (a limit, rule or standard)
cards.example: 交易所放宽了融资保证金比例。
cards.examplePinyin: Jiāoyìsuǒ fàngkuān le róngzī bǎozhèngjīn bǐlì.
cards.exampleMeaning: The exchanges loosened the minimum margin ratio.
cards.note: 书面语/policy register; opposite 收紧. Collocates: 放宽限制, 放宽条件, 放宽政策, 放宽标准. vs 放松 (broader, everyday: 放松心情, 好好放松一下) — 放宽 = widening a boundary/lowering a bar; if the rule has a number in it, it's usually 放宽.
cards.tiesTo: China cuts minimum margin ratio from 100% to 80%

cards.meaning: to mean, signify, imply (a fact's consequence)
cards.example: 融资余额从3万亿元降到2.2万亿元，意味着投资者的信心还没有恢复。
cards.examplePinyin: Róngzī yú'é cóng 3 wàn yì yuán jiàng dào 2.2 wàn yì yuán, yìwèizhe tóuzīzhě de xìnxīn hái méiyǒu huīfù.
cards.exampleMeaning: Margin debt falling from 3 trillion yuan to 2.2 trillion means investor confidence hasn't recovered.
cards.note: Abstract collocation, 书面语/news register: subject = a fact/number/decision, object = its consequence (这意味着…). vs 说明 (shows/demonstrates — evidence proving a point) and 表示 (to express/state — what a person or institution says: 央行表示…). 意味着 = implication for what comes next.
cards.tiesTo: China cuts minimum margin ratio from 100% to 80%
